It feels like I've just been bouncing back and forth between those intense, revved-up highs and these heavy, exhausting lows, without any real middle ground.\n\nDoctor: Considering your experience over the past year, do you think the time spent in the 'revved up' episodes and the low periods combined has been more than half of the year, or would you estimate it as less?\n\nPatient: It has definitely been more than half of the year.
